text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Owww... Phew, that sure startled me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll have to follow the doctor's
orders and
rest for a few days...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I'm totally fine, so you don't
have to get
all upset!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me emergency
treatment right
away, Trainer. That
helped a lot with the pain.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're really amazing! You're as
incredible as the
highest-ranking sumo
wrestlers out there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Speaking of, let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Speaking of, let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Okay. I guess learning by
observation is
important too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All right, I'll do my best to soak
up
everything I see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop Hishi Akebono from running and
have her
rest until the doctor gives her
the okay to start
training again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Let's get started right awa—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer... I know I shouldn't...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, it's too dangerous to
let her run
like this. I decide to have
Hishi Akebono rest until
her leg is fully
healed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to enjoying
every dish
on the training menu you
came up with!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here's to a buono training session! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By taking special consideration of her
injury and
staying focused, we get
through practice without
any issues!
